in_marathi.name: Manushree
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mind, Intelligence, Sage
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manushree हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manushree is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word ‘manas’ which means mind or intelligence. The suffix ‘shree’ denotes a sage or a goddess. The name Manushree signifies one who possesses a brilliant mind and vast knowledge. In Hindu mythology, Manushree is an embodiment of wisdom and knowledge.
